'''Awei''' is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. He can be found chatting with Hongzhen local, [[Xiangping]] (after completing Main Quest '[[Thaw of Eons]]').

==Quests and Events==
''(To be added)''

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Awei:''' There's nothing about this plant anywhere...
:'''Xiangping:''' What's wrong?
:'''Xiangping:''' Oh, what you got there is a [[Silver Lotus]]. We use it for food. It's nothing special.
:'''Xiangping:''' If you're interested , I can give you some from my house.
:'''Awei:''' Thank you, ma'am, but it's all right. I can pick some when I do my research in the mountains.
:'''Xiangping:''' Okay, whatever you like.
:'''Xiangping:''' Come over for dinner, I'll make my signature Silver Lotus dish.
:'''Awei:''' Won't that be too much trouble?
:'''Xiangping:''' No trouble at all! You don't get that outside Mt.Firmament. It is said Silver Lotuses only grow in snow patches where the Sentinel has been.
:'''Awei:''' What? Silver Lotuses have something to do with the Sentinel? It sounds like a myth, but still, it could be a nice subject for a paper...
{{Dialogue End}}
